title: Lifestyle changes may be as effective as therapy at easing depression | New Scientist
description: Advice about mindful eating, enjoying exercise and getting good-quality sleep was at least as effective for treating depression as cognitive behavioural therapy
author: Mary West

title: Severe meningitis outbreak caused by bacteria that took genes from microbiome | New Scientist
description: An unprecedented meningitis outbreak that occurred in Kent, UK, in March seems to have been driven by a bacterial strain taking genes from harmless microbes
author: Carissa Wong

title: Is AI really getting dangerously out of control? | New Scientist
description: Grim warnings of the existential risk posed by AI are all over the news, but there is very little evidence to back them up
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: El Niño heat could kill half a million people by February | New Scientist
description: Higher temperatures around the world due to the record-breaking El Niño will lead to an estimated 450,000 extra deaths by February unless swift action is taken, warn researchers
author: Michael Le Page

title: Fire amoeba breaks heat tolerance record for complex life | New Scientist
description: An amoeba living in a Californian hot spring is thriving above 60°C, a threshold previously thought deadly to complex life
author: James Woodford

title: Should we use GLP-1 drugs to treat obesity in children? | New Scientist
description: Children as young as 8 in the US are being prescribed off-label GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, sparking debate about the potential long-term health effects
author: Alice Klein
